page: Microsoft Azure E112ias_v5 is an isolated memory-optimized instance built on the AMD EPYC 7763 processor architecture. Operating under Microsoft Hyper-V, the configuration provides 112 dedicated vCPUs derived from 56 physical cores running at a base clock speed of 3.525 GHz with simultaneous multithreading enabled. The system features 672 GB of total system RAM, establishing a ratio of 6 GB of memory per vCPU. Hardware cache provisions include 32 KB L1 data cache, 0.5 MB L2 cache, and 32 MB L3 cache. There is no bundled local ephemeral storage, requiring attached remote storage volumes for persistent data operations.

Benchmark results demonstrate significant compute capacity across parallelized operations. In multi-core throughput, the instance achieved a stress-ng score of 151,080.86 and a PassMark CPU score of 84,300.85, both placing within the top tier. Cryptographic performance is equally strong, producing 119,178.14 in the PassMark encryption test, aided by dedicated hardware AES and SHA acceleration. Decompression scalability is demonstrated by a multi-threaded bzip3 rate of 566.51 GB/sec. Conversely, single-core processing exhibits moderate throughput, reflected by a Geekbench 6 single-core score of 1,721.0 and a single-threaded gzip compression rate of 27.69 GB/sec.

Memory-intensive metrics reflect high throughput, scoring 3,140.79 in the PassMark memory evaluation, cached read bandwidth of 6,716.89 GB/sec, and 101.62 million operations per second on Redis SET workloads. Large-block uncached memory operations remain standard, with 126.71 GB/sec read and 62.78 GB/sec write bandwidth. Because the instance contains no local NVMe storage and relies entirely on external volumes, disk I/O performance depends on network-attached storage configuration.

The qualitative cost profile favors high-density infrastructure consolidation, where large memory capacity and multi-threaded throughput reduce the overhead of running multiple smaller nodes. Microsoft Azure E112ias_v5 is suited for enterprise in-memory databases, large Redis caching tiers, distributed data analytics engines, compilation farms, and batch memory-bound parallel computing.
description: Microsoft Azure E112ias_v5 is an isolated memory-optimized virtual machine powered by the AMD EPYC 7763 processor using the x86_64 architecture. It provides 112 dedicated vCPUs across 56 physical cores running at 3.525 GHz alongside 672 GB of RAM, yielding a 6 GB memory-per-core ratio. The instance includes no onboard local storage, depending on external Azure storage volumes, and does not contain discrete GPUs. Synthetic benchmarks show top-tier multi-threaded CPU execution, recording 151,080.86 in stress-ng and 84,300.85 in PassMark CPU, with robust cryptographic performance via hardware AES and SHA support. Memory subsystem benchmarks show high cached throughput and 101.62 million Redis SET operations per second, though large-block uncached memory transfers remain within average tiers. This server configuration is suited for large-scale in-memory databases, distributed data processing, and highly parallelized enterprise workloads requiring compute isolation.
